# enums

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/tgo/internal/lowering/enums"
```

Package enums builds the Go types and functions for an enum declaration.

An enum keeps one variant's data. Callers use constructors and payload methods so the compiler can change its private fields without changing those calls. Payload methods return copies. The checker has already selected the storage layout and checked each source use before this package builds Go declarations.

## func Declarations

```go
func Declarations(specification *ast.TypeSpec, enum *types.Enum, payloads []*ast.StructType, tagType ast.Expr, fresh func() *ast.Ident) []ast.Decl
```

Declarations replaces one checked enum with its Go storage and public API.
